Deep Umbra's Accumulated Shadow, which they feed, reads zoom-16 tiles where gray level 255 is 550 m, so the Rasterize Buildings nodes that feed it keep zoom 16 and a maximum height of 550 m. At zoom 18 the tiles are not the ones the model reads, so the shadows would not come out sharper: they would come out wrong.
